description: Queries over test/fixtures/tools plus test/fixtures/other/jobs.json, a server whose name (`jobs`) is the plural of the resource its tools work on. Each query names a resource word that is also the provider name; `expect` is the tool of that server the query asks for. Guards the provider scope rule (discovery.md, "搜索"): the provider's name must not flatten the idf of the resource word, and a tool named by the query must outrank tools that only mention the word.
